EAU non-muscle-invasive bladder, 2026. Parsed since before corpus v2.0 and never loaded in any release -- it sat in the same folder as the EAU prostate file that was, with the same publisher and the same edition. That omission is what the release manifest now exists to catch.

Unlike AFU TVNIM, this guideline is not organised by risk group. Its treatment chapter is organised by modality -- intravesical chemotherapy, BCG, cystectomy -- and the risk groups appear inside the recommendations rather than as headings. So the honest rule set is short: the document is about NMIBC throughout, and only carcinoma in situ has chapters of its own.

default.note: The whole document is NMIBC guidance. A passage no rule claims is still NMIBC -- resection technique, instillation schedules, follow-up intervals -- and applies at any risk. Absent here means 'risk not narrowed', not 'unknown disease'.
